content.title: Reach the standard-user banking overview with persona, accounts, balances, and transaction visibility
content.intent: Prove that a successful standard_user login lands on the authenticated banking overview and exposes or links to the relevant banking state for that persona.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the standard_user persona as the baseline full-access class; applied auth/permission because the scenario begins with successful authentication; applied state/flow because the path covers landing plus access to dashboard-linked banking information. Risk gate implied strength=3 because money and auth apply, but no combinatorial input matrix was needed because persona is the only outcome-changing class in this baseline path.
